import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/fix_shared_opener.py')
t = p.read_text()
t = t.replace('for (prefix, wrapper) in COMPRESS_WRAPPER_PREFIXES {',
              'for (prefix, wrapper) in DYNAMIC_COMPRESS_WRAPPERS.iter().copied() {')
t = t.replace('let mode_text = mode.as_literal_text(ctx)?;',
              '''// A mode that is not a compile-time literal reads, which is the overwhelmingly
            // common open and what this branch assumed before it knew about `$mode` at all.
            let mode_text = match mode {
                LiteralOpenMode::Operand(operand) => optional_const_string_operand(ctx, operand)?
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "r".to_string()),
                LiteralOpenMode::ReadOnly => "r".to_string(),
            };''')
p.write_text(t)
print('ok')
